## Mandao

Spec-driven development with [Mandao](https://www.npmjs.com/package/mandao): commands are `/mandao-<command>`. Before running one, or editing `specs/` or `docs/constitution/`, read [.mandao/guide.md](.mandao/guide.md).

<!-- mandao:end -->

## Module index

| Module | Path | Purpose | Guide |
|---|---|---|---|
| Content | `core/` | Commands, personas, templates, catalog, model recommendations | `core/AGENTS.md` |
| CLI | `src/cli/` | Commands and prompts | — |
| Engine | `src/engine/` | Sync pipeline, doctor, config and lock IO | — |
| Adapters | `src/adapters/` | Pure canonical → harness rendering | `src/adapters/AGENTS.md` |
| Resolver | `src/resolver/` | overrides > presets > core | — |
| Render | `src/render/` | Tokens, conditionals, template install | — |
| Writer | `src/writer/` | Change plan, drift, orphans | `src/writer/AGENTS.md` |
| Models | `src/models/` | Role → model resolution | — |
| Skills | `src/skills/` | Catalog installs and `git` skill copies | `src/skills/AGENTS.md` |
| Scripts | `src/scripts/` | `mandao run` helpers | — |

| Derived docs | `scripts/diagrams/` | Source-derived diagrams and command pages | — |

Architecture and rules: `docs/constitution/`.

## Evidence and harnesses

Active harnesses are Claude Code, GitHub Copilot and Codex (`.mandao/config.yml`). Codex skills live
under `.agents/skills/`, with agent roles/rules in `.codex/`. A lock recommendation hash records an
already-offered recommendation; enabled harnesses are configured in config.yml and rendered files
are inventoried under lock.files. Never hand-edit the lock.

Query the existing graph before source discovery. Refresh code through `graphify update .`; do not
commit `graphify-out/`. Script-owned evidence is written through the CLI/writer integrity helpers.
